_note: V3 고정 화풍 1종. 캐릭터 image_prompt에 {style_prompt}로 주입됨.

polystyle.label: 폴리 스타일
polystyle.description: 로우폴리 하드 폴리곤 메시 — 평탄한 면, 그라데이션 없음, 6색 고정 팔레트, 3등신 캐릭터
polystyle.base_style_prompt: low-poly hard polygon mesh illustration, all surfaces flat facets no gradients no blending, six-color palette only deep black #111118 dark navy #1A2840 bright blue #4A90D9 white #F5F5F5 natural skin #D4BEA0 crimson red #C0392B accent only, hard geometric shadow edges, 3-head proportion chibi-style characters, Korean drama cinematic framing, no text no written words no letters no labels no signs no captions
polystyle.negative_prompt: photorealistic, smooth shading, gradients, blending, soft shadows, oil painting, watercolor, anime, extra colors outside palette, realistic body proportions, 7-head proportion, 8-head proportion, long neck, elongated body, deformed, extra limbs, text, watermark
polystyle.bg_prompt_suffix: no people no characters, empty architectural scene, low-poly geometric interior or urban exterior, flat facet surfaces, seven-color background palette only near-black #180A20 dark purple #462374 deep mauve #7D2E67 medium purple #B752B8 orchid pink #D67DD1 lavender #AC8AE1 silver-white #DDDDDD, hard geometric shadow edges, cinematic Korean drama setting
polystyle.crimson_rule: crimson red #C0392B on ONE emotional object per scene only — single accent, never on characters
